description: Before every commit, scan staged files for secrets (API keys, private keys, tokens) and refuse to commit if .kiro/ is ignored. Prevents credential leaks and protects the Kiroween requirement that .kiro/ is present in the repo.
name: pre-commit-secret-scan
test: Stage a file containing 'CMC_API_KEY' and run the script; it must exit non-zero and name the file.
